Hi Susan —

Thanks for starting vendor enrollment. Before we can finalize payee activation in our ERP, finance needs:

- A signed W-9 (if US) or W-8 (if non-US) — PDF is fine.
- A redacted bank statement or bank letter showing account name + last 4 digits (routing and account numbers may be masked).
- Your preferred payment rails (ACH or Wire or RTP) and whether you accept rails with structured remittance.
- The exact remittance reference you want on our PO/invoice (example: GB-INV-<invoice#> or vendor internal PO).

Attachment: we will accept a single ZIP with the above, or individual PDFs. Once finance kicks off micro-deposits we’ll confirm amounts and finalize the remit label mapping for POs so payments reconcile automatically.

Can you get the documents uploaded by end of day Friday? If you prefer, I can introduce you to Aditya in Finance to run through the NACHA/ERP mapping in one call.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber

Thanks — attaching the documents you requested.

A few notes:
- We prefer ACH for US payments but can accept wire for initial settlements.
- For remittance, our AP system expects a 10-character reference in the format GB-YYYY-#### (example: GB-2027-0045).
- We also included our corporate payments mailbox (payments@greenbridge.com) on the cc for remittance emails.

If Aditya wants to review the NACHA format, we can provide a sample. Otherwise confirm micro-deposits and we’ll verify.

Thanks for the W-9 and bank letter, they look good. Two quick operational items from Finance:

1) Micro-deposits — we will send two micro-deposits (USD) today to the account on file. Please confirm the amounts once you see them (expected within 24–48 hours).

2) NACHA/ERP mapping — to ensure ACH payments carry the remittance information you asked for, attach the sample NACHA CSV I’ve included in this thread (nacha-sample.csv). Key fields we will populate from our PO:

   - Addenda: custom_remit (we can place your GB-YYYY-#### string in the addenda record for automated matching)

Action items for Greenbridge: confirm which field (addenda or company_entry_desc) you prefer for the GB- reference. If you prefer a sample pre-filled with your PO numbers, send one sample invoice and we’ll return a prefilled NACHA row for validation.

I’ll reply here once the micro-deposits are posted.

Thanks —
